summary: End-to-end tested Size Curve Optimization + Attribute-Grouping Save-to-Buy-Plan enhancement. Backend: 8/8 new integration tests pass, plus 63 existing domain tests (size_curve 13 + attribute_grouping 21 + transfers 27 + display_minimums 2) still green = 77/77. Frontend: /size-curve renders header, category selector defaulted to Apparel (112 SKUs), all 3 tabs (Corporate Curve, Per-Store Curves, Allocate Buy) functional; Allocate 1000 produces exact 1000 total; sidebar link present under INSIGHTS; regression (/attribute-grouping /transfers /dashboard) all load. Save-to-Buy-Plan button backend verified via API; UI button correctly hides in the Compare tab when ratio < 1.5x (observed 1.40x on Apparel vs Accessories — alternate 'no clear winner' state confirmed).

issues: Agent_to_agent_context_note said Apparel vs Accessories yields ~1.6x ratio in demo data, but actual per-SKU ratio observed is 1.40x (9,173 / 6,557), so the 'No clear winner' card is rendered and the Save-to-Buy-Plan button is not visible on this category pair. E1 noted both states are valid; flagging for awareness only. To UI-test the Save button, need either a different category-pair where ratio >=1.5 or to lower the threshold in the frontend. Revenue-per-SKU ratio would be ~2.78x if that were the metric.
Pre-existing React dev-time hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (instrumentation artifact, not a real bug). Carried over from iteration 113.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider documenting that demo-data Apparel vs Accessories per-SKU ratio is 1.40x (not 1.6x as agent-context note suggested), so the Save-to-Buy-Plan UI button does not surface on that pair. The recommend metric the UI uses appears to be units/SKU, not revenue/SKU.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: SizeCurveService kept pure-function core (normalize_distribution, compute_corporate_curve, allocate_by_curve) separated from repository, making unit tests fast. 13 unit tests cover each primitive.
Good: Allocate endpoint validates total_qty>0 via Pydantic Field(gt=0) — 422 returned as spec'd; verified in integration test.
Good: curve_source string ('corporate' vs 'store:{code}') is a nice explicit contract; backend/UI both rely on it.

Good: save-recommendation writes to buy_plan_recommendations collection with tenant_id scoping, source='attribute-grouping-compare', uuid rec_id, and list endpoint projects {_id:0} to avoid Mongo ObjectId leak.

Minor: allocation response returns `allocation` as a dict keyed by size label. Consider also returning it as an ordered list[{size,qty}] for UIs that want deterministic row order without re-sorting by corporate_curve sizes[]. Current UI handles this, but future consumers may trip.
Minor: Footer total 1000 in Allocate Buy uses Array.reduce; rounding safe since allocate_by_curve adjusts largest bucket to force exact sum — verified sum=1000 end-to-end.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all Size Curve tabs, sidebar link, category switch, allocation, and regression routes verified; Save-to-Buy-Plan UI button not exercised because current demo data falls below 1.5x ratio threshold on the suggested pair (but backend API round-trip is verified).

seed_data_creation: None — used production demo data. One test record (TEST_iter114 Apparel vs Accessories) persisted to buy_plan_recommendations during save test (acceptable, no cleanup requested).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Size Curve Optimization + Save-to-Buy-Plan enhancement shipped cleanly. Public API contracts: GET /api/analytics/size-curve/categories returns {categories:[{name,sku_count}], total_categories}; corporate returns {curve:{size:pct}, sizes:[desc]}; allocate returns allocation as dict keyed by size. UI uses native <select> for category switcher — Playwright must use page.select_option. Save-to-Buy-Plan button only renders when compare-ratio >= 1.5x; in current production demo data the Apparel-vs-Accessories per-SKU ratio is 1.40x, so the button shows only on different category pairs or after lowering the ratio threshold in the frontend code. Backend save/list APIs are verified working.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All acceptance criteria met. One context drift noted: agent-context-note claimed Apparel vs Accessories yields ~1.6x ratio but actual per-SKU ratio is 1.40x — this makes the UI show the 'no clear winner' card instead of the Save-to-Buy-Plan button on that pair; both states are legitimate per E1's design.
